title: three-byte address structure in packet scope kept by pinfo->src and read during column fill after the scope ended
live_proof: absent at the 4.6.8 pin by inspection: packet-usbll.c allocates the address with wmem_new0(pinfo->pool, usbll_address_t). The pre-fix shape is quoted from 5a109265a6^ at packet-usbll.c:662-663 (the allocation), :698-699 (the store) and :627-629 (the read).
object: the usbll_address_t structure, three bytes in wmem_packet_scope()
lifetime_ender: wmem_leave_packet_scope at the end of epan_dissect_run_with_taps (epan.c:611 at the fix's parent), before the packet's columns are filled
shape: packet-scope object held by a column or address past the scope's end
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator; the seam's packet pool stands in for the separate wmem_packet_scope() pool, the same allocator type with the same reset
distinguishing: the smallest object in the corpus, a three-byte structure whose first byte is the flags field the stale read tests; the fix moves the allocation to pinfo->pool
sibling_issue: #17368 was closed as a duplicate of #17367: same trace, same fault address, a different fuzz capture
